description: Replaces Prevent sleep while running with /awake: keeps the Mac awake while agents work, also lid closed, then lets it sleep

enabled.title: Stay awake
enabled.description: Keep the Mac awake while turns or subagents run; /awake on|off

lid_closed.title: Lid closed
lid_closed.description: Keep running with the lid closed; needs the authority broker, otherwise only idle sleep is held

grace_seconds.title: Grace period
grace_seconds.description: Seconds to stay awake after the last turn or subagent finishes

battery_floor.title: Battery floor
battery_floor.description: Stop at or below this battery percent while on battery

max_hours.title: Maximum hours
max_hours.description: Stop after this many hours of continuous work (1 to 24)

hotspot_ssid.title: Hotspot network
hotspot_ssid.description: Personal Hotspot network to join when Wi-Fi drops with the lid closed; its password comes from the Keychain
